name: Tun Hamzah
role: Surviving member of the Bendahara kin group
bio: Hamzah knows the names behind his father’s accounts, but merchants who approach him after the purge cannot assume he can act in his father’s place.
notes: fact: Brown says Tahir’s son was wounded in the purge but survived, and later received the same title in exile (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 163, 170)
gameplay: Quay referrals are invented; he is not the old port’s Seri Nara Diraja by virtue of his later title (people-factions.md §2)
